messages.en:
{07 0c 00}Whoever said that{01 00 00 0a 00} caring
for flowers was like caring
for skin was right!
{07 0e 00}No matter how much you
work, they both dry up in
the end{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00} How depressing.
{06 00 00 03 04}
messages.et:
{07 0c 00}Sellel, kes ütles,{01 00 00 0a 00} et lille-
hooldus on nagu nahahoole,
oli õigus!
{07 0e 00}Ükskõik kui palju sa
pingutad, mõlemad kuivavad
lõpuks{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00} Kui masendav.
{06 00 00 03 04}

messages.en:
{07 04 00}Ew, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00}!{01 00 00 05 00} Do you
care at all about your
skin?{01 00 00 05 00} Then take care of it!
{07 1b 00}Even a wilted flower will
perk up with a little bit
of water{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
{06 03 00 05 06}
messages.et:
{07 04 00}Ptüi, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00}!{01 00 00 05 00} Kas su
nahk sind üldse huvitab?{01 00 00 05 00}
Siis hoolitse selle eest!
{07 1b 00}Isegi närtsinud lill
ergastub väikesest
veekogusest{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
{06 03 00 05 06}

messages.en:
{07 15 00}Who was it that said such a
thing?{01 01 00} {07 06 00}Seriously, I need to
know, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 15 00}Kes küll ütles midagi
sellist?{01 01 00} {07 06 00}Tõsiselt, ma pean
teadma, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 16 00}These days, not even boys
are allowed to look scruffy,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 16 00}Tänapäeval ei tohi isegi
poisid räämas välja näha,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 16 00}Girls must take special
care to stay hydrated,{01 00 00 05 00}
{04 02 00}.
{07 19 00}You have such lovely skin,
I can tell you're drinking
your water! {01 00 00 0a 00}{07 14 00}Keep it up!
messages.et:
{07 16 00}Tüdrukud peavad eriti
jälgima, et joovad vett,{01 00 00 05 00}
{04 02 00}.
{07 19 00}Sul on nii armas nahk,
ma näen, et sa jood
vett! {01 00 00 0a 00}{07 14 00}Jätka samas vaimus!

messages.en:
{07 1b 00}Where I used to live,{01 00 00 0a 00} there
was this horrible girl,
{01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 1c 00}{01 00 00 14 00}She scattered garbage
everywhere,{01 00 00 0a 00} and let her
yard go to weeds{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
{07 0e 00}I think if I still lived in
the same town with her, I
might have{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
{07 06 00}No,{01 00 00 05 00} I can't say any more.{01 00 00 14 00}
{07 07 00}Sometimes I'm so mean,{01 00 00 05 00} I
scare myself, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 1b 00}Seal, kus ma varem elasin,{01 00 00 0a 00}
oli üks kohutav tüdruk,
{01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 1c 00}{01 00 00 14 00}Ta puistas prügi
igale poole{01 00 00 0a 00} ja laskis oma
hoovi umbrohtu kasvada{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
{07 0e 00}Arvan, et kui ma elaksin
temaga ikka samas linnas,
oleksin ma{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
{07 06 00}Ei,{01 00 00 05 00} ma ei saa rohkem öelda.{01 00 00 14 00}
{07 07 00}Vahel olen nii kuri,{01 00 00 05 00} et
hirmutan end, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 14 00}When crossbreeding flowers,{01 00 00 05 00}
just plant them close
together and be patient.
{07 13 00}After a while, a new flower
of a different color might
bloom, {04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Lillede ristamisel{01 00 00 05 00}
istuta need lihtsalt
kõrvuti ja ole kannatlik.
{07 13 00}Mõne aja pärast võib
puhkeda uus teist värvi
lill, {04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 19 00}After a day of rain, even
wilted flowers {07 00 00}will perk
right up!
{07 14 00}Watering them with your
{ff 00 00 07}watering can{ff 00 00 00} will do the
same thing, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 13 00}And remember, for both
ladies and flowers,{01 00 00 05 00}
hydration is key!
messages.et:
{07 19 00}Pärast vihmast päeva
ergastuvad {07 00 00}isegi närtsinud
lilled!
{07 14 00}Nende kastmine oma
{ff 00 00 07}kastekannuga{ff 00 00 00} teeb
sama, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 13 00}Ja pea meeles, nii daamide
kui lillede jaoks{01 00 00 05 00}
on niiskus võti!
